combo.description: For a max DPS trade AA and instantly E Q R. AA again, then quickly W W AA.
All in a target by using E and W under the enemy. W again, then quickly R Q and AA.
To create a gap use W underneath yourself and your target, then W again. Finish with E Q and R.
For an ideal pre-6 trade, AA and E under your target. Q and W under them, then AA W.
Use W under yourself then W again to gapclose. Quickly Q and AA your target.
Quick trade by using E then Q AA.
For some poke use E on your target, then W Q W.
